notes: Park at strong: count delta 0.0618% (abs=1). Entries are exact - 1618/1618 TV entries matched at identical bar and price, coverage 100.0%, entry p90 and exit p90 both 0.0000%. The single gating unit is one ENGINE-ONLY trade (long entry 2025-07-20 11:45 @3729.49, exit 11:45 @3762.70), and it is a second-order consequence of one declined exit fill rather than an independent signal. On the 08:30 signal bar (close 3703.48, atr 17.00883529930721) the TP limit is 3737.4976705986146; bar 11:30 has high 3737.53, i.e. the level is cleared by 0.0323 (8.6 ppm). The engine fills that TP at 11:30, goes flat, and the same bar's re-fired strategy.entry("Long") is therefore admitted (pyramiding=1 no longer blocks it), filling at the 11:45 open 3729.49 and hitting the revised TP 3762.69 on the same bar. TV declines the 11:30 fill, so for TV the strategy.exit call at 11:30 merely REVISES the levels and TV books one trade exiting at the new TP. Classified as intrabar-path resolution, not an engine rule: of the 44 exit-side divergences (bar offsets -1 x18, 0 x22, +1 x3, +3 x1), 16 are 'engine exits exactly one bar earlier at exactly the same level price', and for 16 of 16 the level's first breach inside the engine's fill bar occurs in that bar's final 1-minute sub-bar (+14) per the committed 1m source feed. That signature is necessary but NOT sufficient, and the obvious discriminators were tested and falsified: TV DID fill on 43 other bars whose level was likewise first breached only at +14; TV fills 'wick-only' bars (level between close and the far extreme) 877 times; and the breach-margin distributions overlap completely (declined 10.4-3879.5 ppm, median 245; filled 0.0-12237.8 ppm, median 788). Nothing visible in a 15m OHLC bar separates the 16 declines from the 43 accepts - the discriminating information is sub-15m intrabar path, which TV resolves from its own tick stream and which the corpus 15m feed does not carry. This is the same limitation verify_corpus.py already declares when it makes MAE/MFE report-only ('gating on them punishes data resolution, not engine correctness'). A bar-magnifier rerun would not help: the declined breaches are present in the 1m data too. Not a warmup-origin case (the unit is mid-range), not finding-320 (not at the range end), and not the occupancy/admission family (findings 348/350/365) - the engine was genuinely flat, so admitting the entry was correct. Filling when the 15m bar's extreme reaches the level is the only determinate reading of a 15m OHLC bar; do not chase this one.
